preconditions.description: The number of red, green, and blue pixels must be non-negative and within the specified bounds.
The total number of pixels must be greater than zero.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if (a % 2 == b % 2 == c % 2) else stdout == str(min_fights)
postconditions.description: If all pixel counts have the same parity, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum number of fights needed.

postconditions.expression: min_fights == (a + b + c) - max(a, b, c)
postconditions.description: The minimum number of fights is calculated as the total number of pixels minus the maximum count of any single color.
